description: This file defines an interface class IOmiProxy within the omi namespace, which provides methods for managing crypted bundles and handling error listeners. It includes method declarations for mounting and unmounting crypted bundles, registering and unregistering error listeners, and defines related enums and types.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: An interface class providing methods to interact with omi_dbus_api, including bundle management and error listener registration.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its ID and file paths, outputs the decrypted config bundle path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener by its ID.
